feeds.title: Fox Rothschild
feeds.description: North Carolina Appellate Practice Blog is Fox Rothschild's blog about practicing law in North Carolina and offers updates and news regarding State and Federal appellate courts.

feeds.title: Squire Patton Boggs » Sixth Circuit Appellate
feeds.description: The Sixth Circuit Appellate Blog fosters discussion on news and opinions issued by the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit, with an emphasis on civil and regulatory cases affecting business interests.

feeds.title: California Appellate Report
feeds.description: A blog covering thoughts on recent Ninth Circuit and California appellate cases from Professor Shaun Martin at the University of San Diego School of Law.

feeds.title: IMLA Municipal Appellate Practice Blog
feeds.description: The IMLA Municipal Appellate Practice Blog focuses on the full spectrum of appellate and municipal law issues, including environmental, business, education, and telecommunications matters. Follow us and read the latest case notes, commentary, IMLA briefs, tips and tactics from this blog.

feeds.title: The Appellate Strategist
feeds.description: The Appellate Strategist blog provides insights on punitive damages, amicus briefs, appeals and writs, trial consultations and evaluating appeals.

feeds.title: Appellate Advocacy Blog
feeds.description: Law Professor Blogs Network is the network of legal blogs edited primarily by law professors. Our editors are committed to providing the web source of legal news, information, and commentary for law professors, practitioners, & government in their respective fields. At Appellate Advocacy Blog, you can read articles on Appellate Justice, Appellate Practice, Appellate Procedure and more.

feeds.title: Appellate Happenings
feeds.description: Articles about appellate decisions from the federal courts, litigation, and legal writing. Appellate Happenings focuses on developments in appellate courts around the country, focusing primarily on the Supreme Court and federal circuit courts of appeal.
